summary.text: Customers find these fillable ornaments to be of good quality, versatile for crafts and projects, and appreciate their appearance and value for money. The size variety receives mixed feedback - while customers like the variety of sizes, some find them too small. Assembly experiences are mixed, with some finding them very easy to snap together while others say they don't snap together easily. Durability is also mixed, with some saying they're durable enough while others report they come apart too easily.
